sourceFindings.finding: The CvSU paper describes four selected sampling sites within its Cañas River study: Mataas na Lupa (Indang), Mayang Falls (Trece Martires City), Tejero (General Trias City), and Wawa (Rosario). The existing source review records 16 shrimp individuals across six source-named taxa at the Wawa site aggregate.
sourceFindings.siteMethod: Three 10 m by 10 m transects at upstream, midstream and downstream locations, with shrimp captured by dip-frame net and traps.
sourceFindings.coordinateDisposition: The paper says selected-site coordinates are included and Figure 1 maps the four sites. The figure has not been visually reviewed and no coordinate was copied or transcribed.
sourceFindings.dateDisposition: The paper's issue is July-December 2022; a field collection date or sampling window is not stated in the reviewed text.
sourceFindings.rightsDisposition: Item-specific reuse permission remains unresolved. Keep the existing shrimp findings research-only; do not reproduce the table or figure.

sourceFindings.finding: Official EMB indexed excerpts name a Wawa River estuary near proposed Island E in the Rosario coastal project context and expose an actual-fishing-table lead.
sourceFindings.directAccess: Direct PDF requests returned HTTP 403. No fishing-table rows, fish taxa, survey stations or coordinates were transcribed.

sourceFindings.finding: EMB CALABARZON uses Wawa River for a separate feature at Barangay San Rafael, Rodriguez, Rizal.
sourceFindings.identityDisposition: Keep this Rizal namesake separate from both Rosario source leads.

sourceFindings.finding: Five CoL XR Actinopterygii searches across Wawa/Rosario indexed waterBody and locality strings returned zero candidates.
sourceFindings.interpretation: Bounded index result only; it does not indicate fish absence and does not resolve the same-name site.

identityAssessment.physicalRelation: unresolved; could be the same river at a different reach, a connected site, or a distinct feature with a shared name
identityAssessment.disposition: Do not merge the CvSU Wawa (Rosario) sampling site with the EMB-indexed Wawa estuary lead until the figure coordinates and permitted hydrography/EIS station context have been reviewed. Do not merge either Rosario source lead with Wawa River in Rodriguez, Rizal.

nextAction: Visually inspect the CvSU Figure 1 and record any Wawa-site coordinate only with its printed precision and CRS/context. Then compare it against authorized EMB EIS fishing/station locations and permitted hydrography. Preserve the 16-shrimp count only at the source's Wawa site aggregate; do not convert it into fish evidence or a current-presence claim.
